plain: Something, like a reward, that pushes people to act

more.text: That which kindles or inflames; used now in a figurative sense only.
That which moves the mind or operates on the passions; that which incites or has a tendency to incite to determination or action; that which prompts to good or ill; motive; spur.

example.quote: This position will not be disputed so long as it is admitted that the desire of reward is one of the strongest incentives of human conduct; or that the best security for the fidelity of mankind is to make their interests coincide with their duty.
